Unleash your inner creator and step into the world of 3D creation with Rooms – a free app for creative builders, cozy gamers and curious minds.

Why Rooms?
- Endless entertainment: tens of thousands of user generated rooms at your fingertips
- Boundless creativity: edit any thing and every thing
- Build with others: remix other people’s rooms and things
- Get credit for your edits: full remix history visible on every room
- Design your dream space: from quirky games to tranquil havens, craft any space you can imagine
- Free: no strings attached

Features:
- Rooms of all varieties: browse creative dioramas, escape rooms, and more
- Room editing: make your own room by dragging and dropping things and adjusting their properties
- Thing library: add from our library of >8,000 user generated 3D models
- Thing editor: use our built-in block editor to edit things, or make one of your own
- Camera mode: fly through rooms and take virtual photos
- Easy sharing: every room is public at a unique URL, and viewable on iOS and web
